svg.title: TemporalLens: processes, representations and saved products
svg.desc: A dimensioned research architecture, read from data preparation through the foundation CNN, two parallel downstream arms, and shared evaluation. Rounded white boxes are operations, teal stacks are tensors, and folded-corner grey boxes are saved products. F1 dimensions are shown, not F0's reduced smoke-test widths. The CNN and metric primitives exist; reportable training, temperature fitting and downstream runners are not yet implemented. The generative arm produces 256-dimensional EMG features, not waveforms. The language arm maps those features to eight 3072-dimensional soft-prefix vectors. A direct foundation-to-evaluation path bypasses both arms. All fitted calibration parameters use development predictions, never final-test predictions.
svg.text: From multichannel EMG to gesture predictions: what each stage does, produces and saves
F1 / downstream dimensions shown · 18 classes = 17 gestures + rest · tensor sketches are schematic, not recorded data

Robustness (F3–F5): perturb inputs before model inference; definitions / runner pending. Source contracts, implementation limits and figure references: docs/figures/README.md.
